Image 2 is the existing shipped explosion flame/style authority, Image 3 is the shipped smoke style, Image 4 is the shipped independent spark shape/style.
Preserve a compact angular radial impact with asymmetrical pointed flame lobes, a small cream-white hot center, yellow and orange nested bands and a thin red-orange rim. It must be visibly related to Image 2 but more compact and fewer lobes. Use hand-drawn sculpted contours, broad decisive painted color shapes, restrained soft transitions within a band, no universal black outline. Read clearly when the whole burst is only 60-96 pixels across. No microdetail, no confetti cloud, no photoreal smoke, no giant circular shock ring.
